mapper.select: SELECT h.*, u.objectKey FROM ct_profile_image_storage h JOIN ct_upload u ON u.uploadId = h.uploadId WHERE u.userId = #{userId} AND h.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY h.profileImageStorageId DESC

SELECT h.*, u.objectKey FROM ct_profile_image_storage h JOIN ct_upload u ON u.uploadId = h.uploadId WHERE h.profileImageStorageId = #{profileImageStorageId} AND u.userId = #{userId} AND h.deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_profile_image_storage h JOIN ct_upload u ON u.uploadId = h.uploadId SET h.deleted = TRUE WHERE h.profileImageStorageId = #{profileImageStorageId} AND u.userId = #{userId} AND h.deleted = FALSE
